purpose: Give TOPA a reproducible, provenance-preserving search and local-index gateway for arXiv research discovery across arbitrary scientific topics without allowing paper metadata, ranking, or model output to become empirical truth by itself.

remote_source.bulk_rule: Use arXiv bulk/OAI-PMH routes rather than repeatedly hammering the search API for mass harvesting.

portable_search.mode: embedded local index; no separate search server required
portable_search.fallback_reason: Keep TOPA searchable with Python standard-library components when a Tantivy wheel is unavailable.

search_contract.smart_plain_topic_expansion: phrase OR conjunction of meaningful topic tokens in the arXiv all: field

TOPA_integration.repo_assimilator_relationship: arXiv gateway supplies new external source candidates; repo assimilation supplies internal methods, failure modes and routing context.
TOPA_integration.artifact_classifier_relationship: arXiv literature may inform methods and preregistration but may not supply nuclear labels or silently become POSS-I image ground truth.

claim_ceiling: The gateway makes arXiv discoverable and locally searchable for TOPA. It does not validate the scientific claims contained in papers and does not make search ranking a scientific authority.
